What do our groups do?

Meet Jesus-centered people

Groups are like Crosspoint's open table: anyone can come share in the fellowship and find meaningful relationships. Joining groups starts with our Group Connect Event.

Talk and grow

Groups share what they're learning about God and life, and groups share ways you can pray with and for one another. Some groups using our talking points which are just simple questions that follow the sermon.

Build relationships

Groups meet regularly and share freely, so they're a great way to build relationships with others. As you build those relationships, we hope you form the trust to band together as disciples!

All people matter and are welcome.

When do groups meet?

Our groups currently meet on Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Most groups meet up after work, during dinner, or later in the evening!

Where do groups meet?

Our groups meet in homes all across Lynchburg and the surrounding area. Groups also meet in the church when that is the best central location for everyone!

Sign up for grouP CONNECT

Each quarter, we have a group connect event where you can mingle, meet, and then join a group. Fill out the form to get started.
